'
t Brouwerskolkje
is a defunct
restaurant
located in
Overveen
, Netherlands. It was a
fine dining restaurant
that was awarded one
Michelin star
in the period 2006–2008 and two Michelin stars in the period 2009–2012.

[
4

The restaurant closed 14 April 2012. Its successor opened in August as  "
&samhoud places
" in
Amsterdam
which has since been renamed "
&moshik
" after the chef.
